      "rationale": "Prevents critical multisig fund-safety hazards by verifying that imported descriptors match the agreed k-of-n threshold without repeated keys or hidden spend paths. The PR notes that 'fewer signers than the threshold can spend' if root or derived keys collide, directly protecting participants from compromised multisig setups and enabling native multisig workflows (#35645)."
